full_judgment: 6. Excepting saying that the consignment of turret lathe imported by the petitioner was not converted by the free list within the meaning of Sl. No. 1 Annexure VI-C of Public Notice No 54(66)/IMP-R dated 15.7.66 and, therefore. the importation by the petitioner was a violation of section 19 of the Sea customs Act read with section 3(3) of Imports and Exports Control Act, 1950, the respondents did not produce any other notification to show that the turret lathe was not an importable item. As regards the maintainability of the appeal before the Central Board of Revenue it w as submitted tort the appeal was barred by limitation uncle the provisions or section 188 of the Sea Customs Act.
